On rooms: my schedule lists times and events only — it has no room assignments and no room availability, so I can't tell you which room is free. I also don't arrange or book rooms. Room reservations are handled by the department's facilities/scheduling office; they can tell you what is free and take the booking.

I also don't arrange other people's meetings or share anyone's private appointments, so I can't set the staff meeting up for you.

Hi Professor — happy to set up the staff meeting. I checked my week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, 09:00-17:00) and I'm afraid I have no completely free hour anywhere: almost every day is booked back-to-back.

- Mon 23 Nov: 14:00-14:30
- Tue 24 Nov: 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25 Nov: 10:00-10:30
- Wed 25 Nov: 13:00-13:30

Thu 26 and Fri 27 have no gaps at all between 09:00 and 17:00.

So if you need a full hour, it would have to be another week — or one of the 30-minute gaps above, whichever you prefer. Tell me which works and I'll book it.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. Two quick follow-ups:

1. Could you give me the contact (identity) of the department's facilities/scheduling office, so I can ask them which room is free next week and book it?
2. Do you know whether there is a standing slot for the CSE455 staff meeting, or is it booked fresh each week?
